description: Wait for a physical mobile runtime to connect. iOS uses macOS usbmuxd events; Android waits for one exact adb serial to become connected and authorized without selecting or probing a different runtime. The call waits until connection, an explicit deadline, or agent cancellation.

device.description: Exact runtime ID: Android adb serial, or Apple CoreDevice/classic hardware UDID.

platform.description: Platform to wait for; defaults to the active Ceraph platform.

projectDir.description: React Native/Expo project directory. Omit when the coding client's workspace identifies one app; supply it to disambiguate projects.

timeoutMs.description: Optional explicit deadline in milliseconds. Default: none — the call waits forever and relies on the MCP abort signal for cancellation. Set this only when you want a hard cap.

name: rn_wait_for_device
